entries.claim: The dataforge_07 package family is published with Trusted Publishing evidence and fresh-install smoke logs.
entries.claim_policy: May be cited as shipped package evidence for version 0.1.0 only.

entries.claim: The dbt DuckDB integration has fresh-install proof for dry-run/apply/refuse/audit/revert behavior.
entries.claim_policy: May be cited as dbt DuckDB proof; not as cloud warehouse apply evidence.

entries.claim: CSV and DuckDB repairs follow detector, safety, SMT, transaction, audit, and revert gates.
entries.claim_policy: May be cited as verified repair pipeline behavior, bounded to shipped detector families and local/DuckDB backends.

entries.claim: The Cloudflare Workers playground is a dry-run beta surface backed by the Hugging Face Space API.
entries.claim_policy: May be cited as hosted beta playground evidence only; no autonomous or persistent repair claim.

entries.claim: DataForge-0.5B-SFT has public verifier evidence as a smoke/research checkpoint.
entries.claim_policy: May be cited as public SFT verifier evidence, not as production model quality.

entries.claim: DataForge-0.5B-GRPO v1 improved strict macro F1 from 0.0053 to 0.1393 with parse 1.0 and schema-case errors 0.
entries.claim_policy: May be cited only as verified research evidence; not production quality and not a full-family claim.

entries.claim: 0.5B-GRPO v2 completed training and strict eval but failed quality gates and did not upload.
entries.claim_policy: Diagnostic evidence only; must not be cited as a model win.

entries.claim: SFT-v8 schema-distill smoke completed but failed predecessor gates; GRPO-v4 remains blocked.
entries.claim_policy: Diagnostic evidence only; do not continue SFT-v8 rungs or launch GRPO-v4 from this predecessor.

entries.claim: SFT-v9 action-envelope has a passing local curriculum/preflight artifact. Kaggle smoke v1 failed before training on an over-strict P100 capability guard; smoke v2 with the P100-compatible runner is currently running.
entries.claim_policy: Private preflight, infrastructure-failure, and running-smoke evidence only; do not cite as a model-quality win or GRPO predecessor.

entries.claim: GRPO-v4 is staged but blocked until a private SFT-v9 or later predecessor passes promotion gates.
entries.claim_policy: Planning/config evidence only; no training or model-quality claim.

entries.claim: The full original DataForge vision remains gated on external validation and full-family evidence.
entries.claim_policy: May be cited only as roadmap/blocker state.

north_star: DataForge is a verified, reversible data-repair pipeline; models may propose repairs only when evidence shows they improve quality without bypassing safety.
